scenarios.name: Page between staged commands in a short target list

scenario_steps.name: ribbon customization is open in the MCAD Software for the Part Tools target
"2D Sketches" and "3D Annotations" are staged in that order
both staged rows have Large and Text unchecked
the user selects "2D Sketches" in the target list and presses Page Down
both rows remain in their original order with their display options unchecked
both staged rows and their display options remain unchanged
the customization dialog closes without applying the staged commands
